event_name: Time 19:17 2019 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 June 2019 A team representative is required to report to the Stewards at 19:45 in relation to the incident below. No / Driver 99 – Antonio Giovinazzi
incident_time: 19:17 2019 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 June 2019 A team representative is required to report to the Stewards at 19:45 in relation to the incident below.
reason: Alleged breach of Article 6.5.2 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations, per the report from the FIA Technical Delegate, the temperature of the fuel intended for immediate use in car 99, measured at 15:08 was more than thirteen degrees centigrade below the ambient temperature recorded by the FIA appointed weather service provider one hour before the second practice session. The Stewards Nish Shetty Silvia Bellot Tom Kristensen Walter Jobst
rules_referenced: Article 6.5.2 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations
title: Summons Alfa Romeo Racing Car 99 Fuel Temperature
